faqAudit.versionDrift: 2022 launch limits Zhefu to basic cards and Yidu to sole-target uses. Current SSR and Config agree on all cards, any eligible undamaged target, and you discard the revealed entities.

ruleBoundaries.officialBasis: Current text covers all 使用或打出牌 after completion, outside owner actual turn; another target must have Hand cards.
ruleBoundaries.engineMapping: Exactly one optional candidate per genuinely completed use or finished response; genuine response-use is observed once, not again through the normal use window. Canonical Slash unifies normal/fire/thunder. Required discard is one true same-name Hand entity, not a view-as output. Decline means one native normal damage attributed to skill owner. Freeze accepted source and action provenance; pay or damage only once through exact native child returns.

ruleBoundaries.officialBasis: Current text permits one target of the completed Slash or damage-trick use who did not receive damage from that card; it does not require a sole target.
ruleBoundaries.engineMapping: Observe exact completed whole-use final targets and per-target actual native damage history; damage to a different target does not exclude an undamaged candidate. Source selects one eligible living original target, then 0..min(3,frozen target Hand count) opaque slots. Zero selection completes without reveal or empty discard. Publicly reveal selected entities still in the original Hand without moving them solely to reveal; compare the target original owner native effective suit/color, not the source appearance. Same-color revealed entities still in that original Hand and legally discardable are moved in one real native batch; never replace a departed selection. Different colors cause no discard.
